pro_course_detail.description:
*Please note that I give all my lessons on Zoom. Please choose the Zoom option when booking your class.*

Welcome!

If you would like to improve your academic English with a published academic author,  you have come to the right place.

Adapted to your specific requirements and covering the key skills of academic reading, writing, listening and speaking, these lessons will:

- develop your academic English vocabulary;

- improve your ability to construct coherent arguments, both in written and spoken English;

- improve your critical-thinking skills;

- teach you to be a more effective reader, whether you are reading for gist, detail or specific information;

- improve the structure and tone of your written and spoken academic English; and

- increase the overall accuracy and quality of your academic English.

These classes include homework (optional but recommended!).

I have a PhD in political science from the University of London, and my book on British politics was published by Palgrave Macmillan, a major international academic publisher, in 2020. It has been endorsed by leading academics as a 'key text', a 'powerful, critical account', and as 'illuminating and scholarly'. 

In addition, I have a Master's degree in International Relations and a Bachelor's degree in Politics and International Relations. I have also worked as an editor, including on academic texts written by non-native English authors. 

I look forward to hearing from you!

pro_course_detail.description:
This class is not a skype/zoom call. 

This lesson is for any English written/audio work you need checked for corrections (emails, messages, website text, essays, letters, CV, resumes, stories, audio etc.)  

Just send me the work and I will send it back by the end of the lesson time allocated. 

You are welcome to send any questions within a couple of days regarding any corrections. If the text is very technical/abstract I may need to ask some questions for clarification or I will provide suggested notes.

Time needed will depend on font size, amount of corrections and content. Please send me the work before booking so I can estimate how long it will take and whether you need to book a 30/45/60 mins etc. 

Please note if the work is very long such as an essay. You may need to book multiple slots for me to proofread the whole thing. On average I would say a page with size 12 font takes about 30 minutes if many corrections need to made.

Alternatively you can send me an audio recording of you reading something or talking about something and I will write out your mistakes with corrections.
